WITH station_usage AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
       AVG(s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage) AS average_above_overall
FROM station_usage s
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage;
